title: oscore_ctx_free leaves s_seq_initialized set; protect_request lacks freed/recycled guard
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/oscore_ctx.c:348-366,332 + oscore_protect.c:124-142. free() wipes struct but not s_seq_initialized[idx]; protect_request checks only idx>=0+flag never active/identity, so stale pointer increments counter and encrypts under zeroed keys returning OK; recycled-slot reuse could encrypt under another peer key. Mirror fix b: clear flag in free() and/or revalidate active+identity in protect_request.
close_reason: oscore_ctx_free() now clears s_seq_initialized[ctx_idx] under mutex. oscore_protect_request adds !ctx->active guard returning OSCORE_ERR_NO_CONTEXT plus eui64 identity snapshot before unlock, revalidated in the nvm_failed commit path (active+identity gate around rollback and flag-set), exactly mirroring oscore_ctx_set_sender_seq(). All 7 s_seq_initialized touch points audited mutex-disciplined.
